markers.description: Mérida International Airport is the main air gateway to Yucatán state, serving domestic and international flights just southwest of the city center.
markers.name: Mérida International Airport

markers.description: Hacienda Montejo is a restaurant inside Mérida International Airport serving Yucatecan classics like huevos motuleños to departing travelers.
markers.name: Hacienda Montejo

markers.description: La Chaya Maya is a popular Yucatecan restaurant in downtown Mérida known for cochinita pibil, papadzules, and handmade tortillas.
markers.name: La Chaya Maya

markers.description: Erudita is a modern apartment complex with pool and coworking amenities in Temozón Norte, north Mérida, serving as the journey's home base.
markers.name: Erudita

markers.description: Te Extraño, Extraño is a contemporary restaurant in Temozón Norte, north Mérida, serving from-scratch breakfasts and chilaquiles on a leafy terrace.
markers.name: Te Extraño, Extraño

markers.description: Plaza Altabrisa is a large shopping mall in northeast Mérida with department stores, international brands, a cinema, and restaurants.
markers.name: Plaza Altabrisa

markers.description: Women'secret is a Spanish lingerie and loungewear chain with a boutique inside Plaza Altabrisa in Mérida.
markers.name: Women'secret

markers.description: Soriana is a major Mexican supermarket chain, with this Altabrisa-area store serving as a convenient grocery stop in Mérida.
markers.name: Soriana

markers.description: Calvin Klein is an American fashion brand with a boutique at Plaza Altabrisa in Mérida selling apparel and accessories.
markers.name: Calvin Klein

markers.description: Altabrisa Bowling is a bowling alley and entertainment center inside Plaza Altabrisa in northeast Mérida.
markers.name: Altabrisa Bowling

markers.description: Puma Store is the German sportswear brand's retail outlet at Plaza Altabrisa in Mérida, selling athletic shoes and apparel.
markers.name: Puma Store

markers.description: Domino's is the international pizza-delivery chain, with this Mérida branch serving as a quick and familiar meal stop.
markers.name: Domino's

markers.description: Paseo de Montejo is Mérida's grand tree-lined boulevard, famed for its French-inspired 19th-century mansions, monuments, and cafes.
markers.name: Paseo de Montejo

markers.description: The Monumento a Justo Sierra on Paseo de Montejo honors the Campeche-born writer and educator who founded Mexico's national university.
markers.name: Monumento a Justo Sierra

markers.description: The Catedral de San Ildefonso on Mérida's main plaza, completed in 1598, is the oldest cathedral on the American mainland.
markers.name: Catedral de San Ildefonso

markers.description: Menta & Rosa is a pink-and-mint cafe near Paseo de Montejo in Mérida, serving breakfast, brunch, and pastries.
markers.name: Menta & Rosa

markers.description: Crabster Seafood & Grill is a seafood restaurant on the Progreso malecón serving fresh ceviches, crab, and Yucatecan-influenced seafood.
markers.name: Crabster Seafood & Grill

markers.description: Playa de Progreso is the Gulf coast beach at Progreso, Yucatán, a popular seaside escape with calm waters and a long malecón.
markers.name: Playa de Progreso

markers.description: Costco Wholesale is the American membership warehouse club, with this Mérida location serving as a bulk-shopping stop for supplies.
markers.name: Costco Wholesale

markers.description: Yedam is a home-style Korean restaurant and cafe in Mérida's Montebello area, serving bulgogi, japchae, mandu, and Korean coffee.
markers.name: Yedam

markers.description: Smart Fit City Center is a branch of Latin America's largest budget gym chain, located at the City Center complex in north Mérida.
markers.name: Smart Fit City Center

markers.description: Lattejus is a cafe in north Mérida serving iced lattes, chai, thick cookies, and health-focused bowls and sandwiches.
markers.name: Lattejus

markers.description: Cabaña del Pibe is an Argentine steakhouse at La Isla Mérida serving grilled cuts, empanadas, provoleta, and wine.
markers.name: Cabaña del Pibe

markers.description: Cinépolis La Isla is a multiplex of Mexico's largest cinema chain inside the La Isla shopping center in north Mérida.
markers.name: Cinépolis La Isla

markers.description: Kōfuku is a Japanese-Latin fusion restaurant in Mérida's Sodzil Norte, serving yōshoku street food, hirata buns, and sushi tacos.
markers.name: Kōfuku

markers.description: City 32 is a modern mixed-use development in north Mérida combining a lifestyle shopping plaza, offices, and a Camino Real hotel.
markers.name: City 32

markers.description: Smart Fit Urban Center is a branch of the popular Latin American gym chain at the Urban Center complex in northeast Mérida.
markers.name: Smart Fit Urban Center

markers.description: OXXO Cocoyoles is a branch of Mexico's ubiquitous convenience store chain in north Mérida, a practical stop for snacks and essentials.
markers.name: OXXO Cocoyoles

markers.description: Clandestino Café is a specialty coffee shop near Paseo de Montejo in Mérida serving pour-over brews and all-day breakfast.
markers.name: Clandestino Café

markers.description: El Pinar is a 1904 neo-Renaissance mansion on Calle 60 in Mérida that operates as a museum and luxury event venue.
markers.name: El Pinar

markers.description: José Rosé is a bistro and grill in Mérida's 1903 Casona 333, billed as Mexico's first restaurant devoted to rosé wine.
markers.name: José Rosé Bistro & Grill

markers.description: Gran Parque La Plancha is a large urban park in Mérida built on former railway yards, with gardens, lagoons, and promenades.
markers.name: Gran Parque La Plancha

markers.description: Paulo's Pizza is an artisanal pizzeria branch inside Mérida's Gran Parque La Plancha serving wood-fired pizzas, baguettes, and pastas.
markers.name: Paulo's Pizza La Plancha

markers.description: The Railroad Museum of Yucatán at La Plancha park in Mérida displays historic locomotives and railcars from the peninsula's rail era.
markers.name: Railroad Museum of Yucatán

markers.description: Alma Piedra is a cafe on Calle 50 in Mérida's historic center serving breakfast, brunch, and specialty coffee.
markers.name: Alma Piedra Centro

markers.description: Hogarento is a breakfast and brunch restaurant in Temozón Norte, north Mérida, serving home-style morning dishes.
markers.name: Hogarento

markers.description: Parque Zoológico del Centenario is Mérida's historic free zoo and amusement park, opened in 1910 for Mexico's independence centennial.
markers.name: Parque Zoológico del Centenario

markers.description: Santagloria is a Spanish bakery and coffee chain whose first Latin American branch serves pastries and breads at Mérida's La Isla mall.
markers.name: Santagloria Coffee & Bakery La Isla

markers.description: Enigma Rooms is a Mexican escape-room chain whose La Isla Mérida branch offers themed puzzle rooms for groups.
markers.name: Enigma Rooms La Isla

markers.description: Izakaya Sushi is a Japanese restaurant in Mérida's La Isla mall serving fresh sushi, sashimi, and shareable izakaya dishes.
markers.name: Izakaya Sushi

markers.description: Korea Chicken Town is a Korean fried chicken restaurant at Plaza Puerta de Hierro in northeast Mérida, serving traditional dishes and drinks.
markers.name: Korea Chicken Town

markers.description: Galerías Mérida is a large enclosed shopping mall in northwest Mérida anchored by Liverpool, with fashion retailers, dining, and a cinema.
markers.name: Galerías Mérida

markers.description: Zara is the Spanish fast-fashion chain's clothing store inside the Galerías Mérida shopping mall, a practical shopping stop.
markers.name: Zara

markers.description: La Recova is an Argentine-style steakhouse at the City Center complex in north Mérida, serving grilled cuts and empanadas.
markers.name: La Recova

markers.description: Cenotes Santa Bárbara is a park in Homún, Yucatán, where visitors bike or ride rail carts to swim in several cenotes.
markers.name: Cenotes Santa Bárbara

markers.description: The Iglesia de San José de la Montaña at Hacienda Eknakán near Cuzamá is Yucatán's only fully neo-Gothic church, built in the late 1800s.
markers.name: Iglesia de San José de la Montaña

markers.description: Thai Thai is a Thai restaurant in Mérida's Emiliano Zapata Norte neighborhood specializing in pad thai, curries, and som tam.
markers.name: Thai Thai

markers.description: Teya station is the Tren Maya railway stop serving Mérida, connecting the city to destinations across the Yucatán Peninsula.
markers.name: Tren Maya Estación Teya

markers.description: Izamal station is the Tren Maya railway stop outside Izamal, providing rail access to the yellow colonial town.
markers.name: Tren Maya Estación Izamal

markers.description: Kinich is a renowned Yucatecan restaurant in Izamal near the Kinich Kak Moo pyramid, serving regional classics like cochinita pibil.
markers.name: Restaurante Kinich

markers.description: Kinich Kak Moo is a massive Maya pyramid in central Izamal, among the largest pre-Hispanic structures in Yucatán by volume.
markers.name: Pirámide Kinich Kak Moo

markers.description: The Convento de San Antonio de Padua is a 16th-century Franciscan monastery in Izamal built atop a Maya platform, famed for its vast atrium.
markers.name: Convento de San Antonio de Padua

markers.description: Trattoria La Pasta is an Italian restaurant on Paseo de Montejo in Mérida serving homemade pastas and wood-fired pizzas.
markers.name: Trattoria La Pasta Montejo

markers.description: Bryan's Modern Grill is a New York-style grill restaurant in Mérida's Montecristo neighborhood.
markers.name: Bryan's Modern Grill

markers.description: Voltacafé is a Mérida specialty coffee shop whose Altabrisa branch serves pour-over brews, espresso drinks, and pastries.
markers.name: Voltacafé Altabrisa

markers.description: Brasa Parrilla Uruguaya is an Uruguayan steakhouse in Mérida's historic center near Parque La Mejorada, grilling meats over charcoal in traditional parrilla style.
markers.name: Brasa Parrilla Uruguaya
